set.body:
Source: review finding at JobRequest, SlurmCommands.scala:119-121, and Fs2CommandExecutor.scala:136-141.

Problem:
unvalidated Map keys are joined into --export, allowing delimiter/reserved-token injection such as FOO,ALL. The executor can also silently discard names outside its allowlist, making jobs fail mysteriously.

Acceptance:
- Introduce a validated EnvName opaque type at the JobRequest boundary.
- Reject control characters, whitespace, delimiters, reserved Slurm export tokens, and names outside the supported syntax.
- Ensure EnvironmentExportPolicy.Explicit cannot broaden to ALL or inherit ambient state accidentally.
- Return a loud typed diagnostic when executor policy cannot apply a requested override; never silently drop it.
- Cover local, SSH-agent, canonical-wire, and managed-admission round trips.
set.title: P6f.6: Validate environment names and reject dropped overrides
